docs.title: AI Telegram Bot
docs.text:
A production-grade, asynchronous Telegram group and private assistant powered by Google's Gemini 3 and Gemma 4 Free-Tier APIs.

Features automated hourly background digests, on-demand time-sliced summaries (/summary <hours>), web-grounded Q&A with Google Search, image analysis via Gemini Vision, and a closed-world anti-hallucination verification engine.

docs.title: Key Highlights
docs.text:
• Pure Free Tier Cloud Engine: Relies 100% on free-tier Gemini and Gemma API models with automated fallback cascades (gemini-3.8-flash, gemma-4-31b-it, gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-flash-lite).
  • Closed-World Anti-Hallucination Pipeline: Summaries validate every topic and decision against real message IDs and speaker names stored in the database. Hallucinated facts, fabricated participants, or phantom promises are pruned automatically.
  • Hourly Background Digest & Periodic Cleanup: Continuous background task collects and summarizes chat messages every hour without holding SQLite transactions open, keeping subsequent /summary queries lightning-fast and quota-friendly.
  • Rich Context Ingestion: Captures message replies (↩ #1045 Author: "..."), Telegram 2.0 quote fragments, topic roots, forwarded channels, and media placeholders.
  • Per-Chat Command Scoping: Dynamically registers native bot command menus for individual chats and groups.
  • Docker & Security Hardened: Runs as a non-root user (botuser, UID 10001), automated dependency auditing via pip-audit, Bandit static security analysis, and Ruff linting.

docs.title: Architecture & Design
docs.text: The bot follows a layered, modular asynchronous architecture powered by aiogram 3, SQLAlchemy (Async), and Google's GenAI SDK.

    subgraph Handlers
        Router --> CmdHandler[commands.py]

    end

        GroupHandler -->|Ingest Message, Quote, Reply| SQLite[(SQLite Database)]

docs.title: 1. Ingestion Engine (app/handlers/group_events.py)
docs.text:
• Filters service messages (join/left events, pin notifications).
  • Extracts rich reply metadata:
  • reply_to_message_id, reply_to_author, reply_to_snippet
  • Quoted text fragments (Telegram 2.0 quotes)
  • Topic/Thread IDs (message_thread_id)
  • Media placeholders ([photo], [voice], [document: spec.pdf])
  • Forwarded message origins ([forwarded: channel: TechNews])
  • Tracks message edits (edited_message) by updating text and edited_at without resetting is_processed.

docs.title: 2. Context Builder (app/services/context_builder.py)
docs.text:
• Raw-First Strategy: If all messages within the requested time slice fit within summary_raw_message_limit and summary_raw_char_limit, the builder operates in Pure Raw Mode, avoiding lossy intermediate digests.
  • Orphan Hydration: If a message in the window replies to an earlier message outside the window, the parent message is batch-fetched from the database and placed into a dedicated [PRE-PERIOD CONTEXT] block.
  • Namesake Disambiguation: When different participants share the same display name, usernames (@username) or user IDs (#12345) are automatically appended.

docs.title: 3. Anti-Hallucination Verifier (app/services/summary_verifier.py)
docs.text:
• Employs a closed-world assumption:
  • evidence_msg_ids: Every topic and decision must cite concrete integer message IDs present in the transcript.
  • valid_speakers: Participants attributed to statements or decisions must exist in the chat window.
  • Fabricated claims, hallucinated participants, or phantom action items are purged before rendering.

docs.title: 4. Background Scheduler
docs.text:
• Runs continuously via an asyncio.Task inside the main process without heavy external dependencies like APScheduler.
  • Aggregates unprocessed messages into hourly digests (ChatDigest) in batches of 200.
  • Keeps SQLite connections open only during fast fetch and commit operations, leaving the database unlocked during LLM network calls.
  • Prunes expired records based on RETENTION_DAYS.

  • Bandit: Static application security testing (SAST) scanning for unsafe SQL execution, shell injection, and secret leakage.
  • pip-audit: Scans installed dependencies against the Python Packaging Advisory Database for known CVEs.

  • Context building, orphan hydration, and namesake disambiguation.
  • Anti-hallucination verification, citation generation, and JSON parsing.
  • Gemini service fallback cascades, 429 quota backoff, and 404 model TTL.

docs.text: Variable Default Value Description BOT_TOKEN Required Telegram Bot API token obtained from @BotFather. GEMINI_API_KEY Required Google Gemini API key obtained from Google AI Studio. GEMINI_ASK_MODEL gemini-3.8-flash Primary model for /ask, user pings, and web search queries. GEMINI_SUMMARY_MODEL gemma-4-26b-a4b-it Primary model for generating hourly digests and period summaries.   3. gemma-4-26b-a4b-it
  4. gemini-3.6-flash

  3. gemini-3.1-flash-lite

docs.text: This document outlines deployment options and production security recommendations.

docs.title: Docker Deployment (Recommended)
docs.text: The repository provides a multi-stage, non-root Docker setup optimized for minimal footprint and security.

docs.title: 1. Build and Run via Docker Compose
docs.text: docker compose up -d --build

docs.title: 2. Inspect Running Container & Logs
docs.text: docker compose logs -f bot

docs.title: 3. File Permissions (Linux Bind-Mounts)
docs.text:
The container runs as non-root user botuser with UID 10001 and GID 10001. If using a bind-mount directory for ./data, ensure ownership matches:

mkdir -p data
sudo chown -R 10001:10001 data

docs.title: Standalone Systemd Service (Linux Host)
docs.text:
To run the bot as a background systemd service on Ubuntu/Debian:

Create /etc/systemd/system/ai-tg-bot.service:

[Unit]
Description=AI Telegram Bot Service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=botuser
WorkingDirectory=/opt/ai-tg-bot
EnvironmentFile=/opt/ai-tg-bot/.env
ExecStart=/opt/ai-tg-bot/venv/bin/python -m app.main
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

Enable and start the service:

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable ai-tg-bot
sudo systemctl start ai-tg-bot
sudo systemctl status ai-tg-bot

docs.title: build_summary_context(session, chat_id, cutoff_utc, hours) async
docs.text:
Builds context for /summary using a Raw-First strategy: 1) If all raw messages in period exist in ChatLog and fit within limits (summary_raw_message_limit and summary_raw_char_limit), uses purely raw messages with hydrated orphan replies (Pure Raw Mode), without lossy intermediate digests. 2) If message count exceeds limit or older raw logs were pruned, combines hourly ChatDigest records for the period with fresh raw ChatLog messages.

Source code in app/services/context_builder.py 
async def build_summary_context(
    session: AsyncSession,
    chat_id: int,
    cutoff_utc: datetime,
    hours: float,
) -> SummaryContextBundle:
    """
    Builds context for /summary using a Raw-First strategy:
    1) If all raw messages in period exist in ChatLog and fit within limits
       (summary_raw_message_limit and summary_raw_char_limit), uses purely raw
       messages with hydrated orphan replies (Pure Raw Mode), without lossy intermediate digests.
    2) If message count exceeds limit or older raw logs were pruned,
       combines hourly ChatDigest records for the period with fresh raw ChatLog messages.
    """
    raw_msg_limit = int(getattr(settings, "summary_raw_message_limit", 400))
    raw_char_limit = int(getattr(settings, "summary_raw_char_limit", 60000))

    count_stmt = select(func.count(ChatLog.message_id)).where(
        ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id,
        ChatLog.timestamp >= cutoff_utc,
    )
    total_available_messages = (await session.execute(count_stmt)).scalar_one() or 0

    raw_stmt = (
        select(ChatLog, User)
        .outerjoin(User, ChatLog.user_id == User.user_id)
        .where(
            ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id,
            ChatLog.timestamp >= cutoff_utc,
        )
        .order_by(ChatLog.timestamp.desc(), ChatLog.message_id.desc())
        .limit(raw_msg_limit)
    )
    raw_rows_fetched = list(reversed((await session.execute(raw_stmt)).all()))
    raw_rows: list[tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] = [(r[0], r[1]) for r in raw_rows_fetched]

    # Check Pure Raw Mode eligibility
    if 0 < total_available_messages <= raw_msg_limit and raw_rows:
        orphan_parents = await hydrate_orphan_parents(
            session, chat_id, [log for log, _ in raw_rows]
        )
        bundle = format_messages_for_digest(raw_rows, orphan_parents=orphan_parents)
        if len(bundle.transcript_text) <= raw_char_limit:
            return bundle

    # Combine ChatDigest + fresh/tail ChatLog mode (or truncated raw messages)
    digest_time_expr = func.coalesce(ChatDigest.period_end, ChatDigest.created_at)
    digest_order_expr = func.coalesce(ChatDigest.period_start, ChatDigest.created_at)
    d_stmt = (
        select(ChatDigest)
        .where(
            ChatDigest.chat_id == chat_id,
            digest_time_expr >= cutoff_utc,
        )
        .order_by(digest_order_expr.asc(), ChatDigest.id.asc())
        .limit(200)
    )
    digests = list((await session.execute(d_stmt)).scalars().all())

    if not digests and not raw_rows:
        return SummaryContextBundle(
            transcript_text="<chat_transcript>\n</chat_transcript>",
            valid_msg_ids=set(),
            valid_speakers=set(),
            message_count=0,
            digest_count=0,
            was_truncated=False,
            total_available_messages=0,
            period_start=None,
            period_end=None,
            single_digest_fast_path=None,
            raw_fallback_lines=[],
        )

    # Determine which raw messages to append after digests
    selected_raw_rows: list[tuple[ChatLog, User | None]]
    if digests:
        max_digest_end: datetime | None = None
        for d in digests:
            d_end = getattr(d, "period_end", None) or getattr(d, "created_at", None)
            if d_end is not None and (max_digest_end is None or d_end > max_digest_end):
                max_digest_end = d_end

        tail_rows = [
            (log, user)
            for log, user in raw_rows
            if not getattr(log, "is_processed", False)
            or (max_digest_end is not None and getattr(log, "timestamp", None) is not None and log.timestamp > max_digest_end)
        ]
        selected_raw_rows = tail_rows
    else:
        selected_raw_rows = raw_rows

    orphan_parents = await hydrate_orphan_parents(
        session, chat_id, [log for log, _ in selected_raw_rows]
    )
    orphan_list = sorted(
        orphan_parents.values(),
        key=lambda pair: (
            getattr(pair[0], "timestamp", None) or datetime.min,
            getattr(pair[0], "message_id", 0),
        ),
    )

    all_pairs = [*orphan_list, *selected_raw_rows]
    label_map, valid_speakers = _build_speaker_resolver(all_pairs)

    msg_lookup: dict[int, tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] = {}
    for log, user in orphan_list:
        msg_lookup[log.message_id] = (log, user)
    for log, user in selected_raw_rows:
        msg_lookup[log.message_id] = (log, user)
        if getattr(log, "reply_to_author", None):
            valid_speakers.add(str(log.reply_to_author).strip())

    valid_msg_ids: set[int] = {log.message_id for log, _ in selected_raw_rows}
    valid_msg_ids.update(orphan_parents.keys())

    digest_blocks: list[str] = []
    fallback_lines: list[str] = []

    for d in digests:
        _extract_metadata_from_digest(d, valid_msg_ids, valid_speakers)
        p_start = getattr(d, "period_start", None)
        p_end = getattr(d, "period_end", None) or getattr(d, "created_at", None)
        if p_start and p_end:
            time_header = f"{format_kyiv_datetime(p_start)} — {format_kyiv_datetime(p_end)}"
        else:
            time_header = format_kyiv_datetime(p_end)
        msg_cnt = getattr(d, "message_count", None)
        cnt_str = f" ({msg_cnt} повід.)" if msg_cnt else ""
        block = f"[Дайджест за період {time_header}{cnt_str}]\n{d.digest_text}"
        digest_blocks.append(block)
        fallback_lines.append(block)

    formatted_raw_lines = _format_rows_with_threads(selected_raw_rows, label_map, msg_lookup)

    was_truncated = total_available_messages > raw_msg_limit and not digests

    # Control character limit raw_char_limit (retaining newest messages)
    digests_section_text = "\n\n".join(digest_blocks)
    reserved_chars = len(digests_section_text) + 500
    available_for_raw = max(4000, raw_char_limit - reserved_chars)

    kept_raw_lines: list[str] = []
    running_chars = 0
    for line in reversed(formatted_raw_lines):
        line_len = len(line) + 1
        if running_chars + line_len > available_for_raw and kept_raw_lines:
            was_truncated = True
            break
        kept_raw_lines.append(line)
        running_chars += line_len
    kept_raw_lines.reverse()

    for log, user in selected_raw_rows[-len(kept_raw_lines) if kept_raw_lines else 0 :]:
        fallback_lines.append(
            f"• [{format_kyiv_datetime(getattr(log, 'timestamp', None), include_date=True)}] "
            f"{_resolve_speaker(log, user, label_map)}: {getattr(log, 'text', '')}"
        )

    transcript_parts: list[str] = ["<chat_transcript>"]
    if digest_blocks:
        transcript_parts.append("[ПОПЕРЕДНІ ПОГОДИННІ ДАЙДЖЕСТИ ЗА ПЕРІОД]")
        transcript_parts.append(digests_section_text)
        transcript_parts.append("")

    if orphan_list and kept_raw_lines:
        transcript_parts.append(
            "[КОНТЕКСТ ДО ПЕРІОДУ (лише для розуміння відповідей, не включати як нові події)]"
        )
        for log, user in orphan_list:
            transcript_parts.append(_format_single_message_line(log, user, label_map, msg_lookup))
        transcript_parts.append("")

    if kept_raw_lines:
        section_title = (
            "[СВІЖІ ПОВІДОМЛЕННЯ ЧАТУ]" if digest_blocks else "[ПОВІДОМЛЕННЯ ЗА ПЕРІОД]"
        )
        transcript_parts.append(section_title)
        transcript_parts.extend(kept_raw_lines)

    transcript_parts.append("</chat_transcript>")

    all_timestamps: list[datetime] = []
    for d in digests:
        for dt_attr in ("period_start", "period_end", "created_at"):
            dt_val = getattr(d, dt_attr, None)
            if dt_val is not None:
                all_timestamps.append(dt_val)
    for log, _ in selected_raw_rows:
        dt_val = getattr(log, "timestamp", None)
        if dt_val is not None:
            all_timestamps.append(dt_val)

    period_start = min(all_timestamps) if all_timestamps else None
    period_end = max(all_timestamps) if all_timestamps else None

    single_digest_fast_path: str | None = None
    if len(digests) == 1 and not selected_raw_rows:
        single_digest_fast_path = digests[0].digest_text

    # Effective message count calculation
    if digests:
        digest_msg_sum = sum((getattr(d, "message_count", None) or 0) for d in digests)
        effective_msg_count = digest_msg_sum + len(selected_raw_rows)
        if effective_msg_count == 0:
            effective_msg_count = total_available_messages or len(digests)
    else:
        effective_msg_count = len([
            line for line in kept_raw_lines
            if not line.startswith("[Тема/Топік") and not line.startswith("[Загальний потік")
        ])

    return SummaryContextBundle(
        transcript_text="\n".join(transcript_parts),
        valid_msg_ids=valid_msg_ids,
        valid_speakers=valid_speakers,
        message_count=effective_msg_count,
        digest_count=len(digests),
        was_truncated=was_truncated,
        total_available_messages=max(total_available_messages, effective_msg_count),
        period_start=period_start,
        period_end=period_end,
        single_digest_fast_path=single_digest_fast_path,
        raw_fallback_lines=fallback_lines,
    )

docs.title: format_kyiv_datetime(dt, include_date=True)
docs.text:
Converts naive UTC (or aware) datetime to Europe/Kyiv timezone and formats as '%m-%d %H:%M' (if include_date=True) or '%H:%M' (if False).

Source code in app/services/context_builder.py 
def format_kyiv_datetime(dt: datetime | None, include_date: bool = True) -> str:
    """
    Converts naive UTC (or aware) datetime to Europe/Kyiv timezone
    and formats as '%m-%d %H:%M' (if include_date=True) or '%H:%M' (if False).
    """
    if dt is None:
        return "--.-- --:--" if include_date else "--:--"
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        aware_utc = dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    else:
        aware_utc = dt
    kyiv_dt = aware_utc.astimezone(KYIV_TZ)
    return kyiv_dt.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M" if include_date else "%H:%M")

docs.title: format_messages_for_digest(rows, orphan_parents=None)
docs.text:
Formats a batch of messages (ChatLog, User | None) for hourly digest generation. Includes context section for parent messages outside window and main message section inside ....

Source code in app/services/context_builder.py 
def format_messages_for_digest(
    rows: list[tuple[ChatLog, User | None]],
    orphan_parents: dict[int, tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] | None = None,
) -> SummaryContextBundle:
    """
    Formats a batch of messages (ChatLog, User | None) for hourly digest generation.
    Includes context section for parent messages outside window
    and main message section inside <chat_transcript>...</chat_transcript>.
    """
    normalized_rows: list[tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] = [
        (r[0], r[1]) for r in rows
    ]
    orphan_dict = orphan_parents or {}
    orphan_list = sorted(
        orphan_dict.values(),
        key=lambda pair: (
            getattr(pair[0], "timestamp", None) or datetime.min,
            getattr(pair[0], "message_id", 0),
        ),
    )

    all_pairs = [*orphan_list, *normalized_rows]
    label_map, valid_speakers = _build_speaker_resolver(all_pairs)

    msg_lookup: dict[int, tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] = {}
    for log, user in orphan_list:
        msg_lookup[log.message_id] = (log, user)
    for log, user in normalized_rows:
        msg_lookup[log.message_id] = (log, user)
        if getattr(log, "reply_to_author", None):
            valid_speakers.add(str(log.reply_to_author).strip())

    transcript_parts: list[str] = ["<chat_transcript>"]

    if orphan_list:
        transcript_parts.append(
            "[КОНТЕКСТ ДО ПЕРІОДУ (лише для розуміння відповідей, не включати як нові події)]"
        )
        for log, user in orphan_list:
            transcript_parts.append(_format_single_message_line(log, user, label_map, msg_lookup))
        transcript_parts.append("")

    transcript_parts.append("[ПОВІДОМЛЕННЯ ЗА ПЕРІОД]")
    main_lines = _format_rows_with_threads(normalized_rows, label_map, msg_lookup)
    transcript_parts.extend(main_lines)
    transcript_parts.append("</chat_transcript>")

async def hydrate_orphan_parents(
    session: AsyncSession,
    chat_id: int,
    logs: list[ChatLog],
) -> dict[int, tuple[ChatLog, User | None]]:
    """
    Finds all reply_to_message_id in logs not present in current window
    and fetches them from ChatLog with User in a single batch query.
    """
    if not logs:
        return {}

    present_ids = {getattr(log, "message_id", None) for log in logs}
    missing_ids = {
        getattr(log, "reply_to_message_id", None)
        for log in logs
        if getattr(log, "reply_to_message_id", None) is not None
        and getattr(log, "reply_to_message_id", None) not in present_ids
    }
    missing_int_ids = [int(mid) for mid in missing_ids if mid is not None]
    if not missing_int_ids:
        return {}

    stmt = (
        select(ChatLog, User)
        .outerjoin(User, ChatLog.user_id == User.user_id)
        .where(
            ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id,
            ChatLog.message_id.in_(missing_int_ids),
        )
        .order_by(ChatLog.timestamp.asc(), ChatLog.message_id.asc())
    )
    fetched = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
    return {row[0].message_id: (row[0], row[1]) for row in fetched}

class GeminiService:
    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        key = api_key or settings.gemini_api_key or "DUMMY_KEY_FOR_INIT"
        self.client = genai.Client(api_key=key)
        self._unavailable_models: dict[str, float] = {}

    def _is_model_unavailable(self, model_name: str) -> bool:
        blocked_at = self._unavailable_models.get(model_name)
        if blocked_at is None:
            return False
        if (time.monotonic() - blocked_at) >= UNAVAILABLE_MODEL_TTL_SECONDS:
            self._unavailable_models.pop(model_name, None)
            return False
        return True

    def _build_model_chain(self, primary: str, fallbacks: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        chain: list[str] = []
        for m in [primary, *fallbacks]:
            if m and m not in chain and not self._is_model_unavailable(m):
                chain.append(m)
        return chain or [primary]

    async def _generate_with_fallback(
        self,
        model_chain: list[str],
        contents: list | str,
        system_instruction: str | None = None,
        temperature: float = 0.3,
        use_search: bool = False,
        minimal_thinking: bool = False,
        response_mime_type: str | None = None,
        response_schema: type | None = None,
        raw_output: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        last_error: Exception | None = None

        for model_name in model_chain:
            # Only legacy Gemma 3 models lacked system_instruction and google_search;
            # Gemma 4 supports system_instruction, google_search, and thinking_config.
            is_legacy_gemma = model_name.startswith("gemma-3-")
            search_attempts = [True, False] if (use_search and not is_legacy_gemma) else [False]

            for with_search in search_attempts:
                config_kwargs: dict = {"temperature": temperature}
                actual_contents = contents

                if system_instruction:
                    if is_legacy_gemma:
                        if isinstance(contents, str):
                            actual_contents = f"{system_instruction}\n\n{contents}"
                        elif isinstance(contents, list) and contents and isinstance(contents[0], str):
                            actual_contents = [f"{system_instruction}\n\n{contents[0]}", *contents[1:]]
                    else:
                        config_kwargs["system_instruction"] = system_instruction

                if with_search:
                    config_kwargs["tools"] = [{"google_search": {}}]

                if minimal_thinking and model_name.startswith("gemma-4-") and hasattr(types, "ThinkingConfig"):
                    try:
                        config_kwargs["thinking_config"] = types.ThinkingConfig(thinking_level="minimal")
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                if response_mime_type and not is_legacy_gemma:
                    config_kwargs["response_mime_type"] = response_mime_type
                if response_schema is not None and not is_legacy_gemma:
                    config_kwargs["response_schema"] = response_schema

                try:
                    try:
                        response = await self.client.aio.models.generate_content(
                            model=model_name,
                            contents=actual_contents,
                            config=types.GenerateContentConfig(**config_kwargs),
                        )
                    except Exception as inner_exc:
                        inner_err_str = str(inner_exc)
                        # If model or API version rejected thinking_config or response_schema with 400,
                        # retry once without those options before falling back to the next model.
                        if (
                            ("400" in inner_err_str or "INVALID_ARGUMENT" in inner_err_str)
                            and any(
                                k in config_kwargs
                                for k in ("thinking_config", "response_schema", "response_mime_type")
                            )
                        ):
                            logger.info(
                                "Model %s rejected advanced configuration options (%s), retrying without them.",
                                model_name,
                                inner_err_str,
                            )
                            config_kwargs.pop("thinking_config", None)
                            config_kwargs.pop("response_schema", None)
                            if is_legacy_gemma or "response_mime_type" in inner_err_str:
                                config_kwargs.pop("response_mime_type", None)
                            response = await self.client.aio.models.generate_content(
                                model=model_name,
                                contents=actual_contents,
                                config=types.GenerateContentConfig(**config_kwargs),
                            )
                        else:
                            raise

                    if response.text and response.text.strip():
                        return response.text.strip() if raw_output else strip_markdown(response.text)

                    finish_reason = None
                    if getattr(response, "candidates", None):
                        finish_reason = getattr(response.candidates[0], "finish_reason", None)
                    logger.warning(
                        "Model %s (search=%s) returned empty response (finish_reason=%s).",
                        model_name,
                        with_search,
                        finish_reason,
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    last_error = e
                    err_str = str(e)
                    logger.warning(
                        "Model %s (search=%s) returned error: %s",
                        model_name,
                        with_search,
                        err_str,
                    )
                    if "404" in err_str or "NOT_FOUND" in err_str:
                        self._unavailable_models[model_name] = time.monotonic()
                        break
                    if "429" in err_str or "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED" in err_str:
                        # Do not retry the same model without search if quota is exhausted (429)!
                        break
                    if not with_search:
                        break

        raise RuntimeError(str(last_error) if last_error else "Unknown Gemini API error")

        (with Google Search and Gemini Vision image understanding).
        """
        system_instruction = (
            "Ти — розумний пошуковий та аналітичний ШІ-асистент у Telegram. "
            "Твоє завдання — давати точні, зрозумілі, актуальні відповіді українською мовою, "
            "шукати свіжу інформацію в інтернеті або зрозуміло пояснювати складні речі. "
            "ВАЖЛИВО: Пиши виключно звичайним чистим текстом БЕЗ Markdown-форматування. "
            "Суворо заборонено використовувати символи **, *, #, ##, ###, `, ``` або іншу розмітку. "
            "Для списків використовуй нумерацію (1., 2.) або символ •."
        )

        contents: list | str
        if image_bytes:
            contents = [
                query,

            ]
        else:

        use_search = settings.gemini_enable_search and not image_bytes
        model_chain = self._build_model_chain(settings.gemini_ask_model, ASK_FALLBACK_MODELS)

        try:

                    "Зачекайте хвилину або перевірте квоти ключа у Google AI Studio."

    async def _run_self_check_pass(
        self,
        bundle: SummaryContextBundle,

        model_chain: list[str],
    ) -> ChatSummarySchema:
        """Optional second pass (Pass-2 Self-Check) for additional fact verification."""
        prompt = (
            f"Чернетка JSON-звіту для перевірки:\n{draft.model_dump_json(indent=2)}\n\n"
            f"Сирий транскрипт чату:\n{bundle.transcript_text}"

    async def generate_verified_summary(
        self,
        bundle: SummaryContextBundle,
        chat_id: int | None = None,
        chat_username: str | None = None,
        show_citations: bool = True,
        header_note: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[str, ChatSummarySchema | None]:
        """
        Generates structured JSON summary from transcript, validates all message_ids and participants
        via verify_and_prune_summary, and renders final clean text.
        """
        if bundle.single_digest_fast_path and bundle.message_count == 0 and bundle.digest_count == 1:
            fast_text = bundle.single_digest_fast_path
            if header_note:
                fast_text = f"ℹ️ {header_note}\n\n{fast_text}"
            return fast_text, None

        model_chain = self._build_model_chain(settings.gemini_summary_model, SUMMARY_FALLBACK_MODELS)
        raw_json_text = await self._generate_with_fallback(
            model_chain=model_chain,
            contents=bundle.transcript_text,
            system_instruction=SUMMARY_JSON_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION,
            temperature=0.0,
            use_search=False,
            minimal_thinking=True,
            response_mime_type="application/json",
            response_schema=ChatSummarySchema,
            raw_output=True,
        )

        parsed = parse_summary_json(raw_json_text)
        if parsed is None:
            logger.warning("Model returned invalid JSON during summary, retrying without response_schema.")
            raw_json_retry = await self._generate_with_fallback(
                model_chain=model_chain,
                contents=(
                    f"{bundle.transcript_text}\n\n"
                    "Поверни ВИКЛЮЧНО валідний JSON об'єкт за схемою ChatSummarySchema без жодного тексту навколо."
                ),
                system_instruction=SUMMARY_JSON_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION,
                temperature=0.0,
                use_search=False,
                minimal_thinking=True,
                response_mime_type="application/json",
                response_schema=None,
                raw_output=True,
            )
            parsed = parse_summary_json(raw_json_retry)
            if parsed is None:
                raise ValueError("Failed to parse model JSON response for chat summary.")

        verified = verify_and_prune_summary(
            parsed,
            bundle.valid_msg_ids,
            bundle.valid_speakers,
        )

        if getattr(settings, "summary_enable_self_check", False) and (
            verified.topics or verified.decisions_and_outcomes
        ):
            verified = await self._run_self_check_pass(bundle, verified, model_chain)

        rendered = render_summary_text(
            verified,
            chat_id=chat_id,
            chat_username=chat_username,
            show_citations=show_citations,
            header_note=header_note,
        )
        return rendered, verified

        self,
        messages_input: SummaryContextBundle | str,
        chat_id: int | None = None,

            try:
                rendered, _ = await self.generate_verified_summary(
                    messages_input,
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    show_citations=False,

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error("Failed to generate verified hourly digest: %s", e)
                return None

    async def summarize_chat_period(
        self,
        hourly_digests: list[str],
        recent_messages_text: str,
        hours_label: str,
        total_items_desc: str,
        bundle: SummaryContextBundle | None = None,
        chat_id: int | None = None,
        chat_username: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Generates chat summary for specified period of time.
        If SummaryContextBundle is provided, uses verified JSON pipeline.
        """
        if bundle is not None:
            header_note = None
            if bundle.was_truncated:
                header_note = (
                    f"Враховано останні {bundle.message_count} із "
                    f"{bundle.total_available_messages} повідомлень."

            try:

            return f"📋 Підсумок чату за останні {hours_label} ({total_items_desc}):\n\n{hourly_digests[0]}"

        system_instruction = (
            "Ти — точний аналітик і стенографіст групового Telegram-чату. "
            "На основі наведених погодинних дайджестів та свіжих повідомлень учасників "
            "сформуй чіткий підсумковий звіт українською мовою.\n"
            "Структура звіту:\n"
            "1. Головні теми обговорення (коротко по пунктах через •, хто і про що говорив).\n"
            "2. Ключові висновки, відповіді або домовленості (якщо були).\n\n"
            "СУВОРІ ПРАВИЛА:\n"
            "• Використовуй ТІЛЬКИ факти з наведених даних. Категорично заборонено вигадувати те, чого не писали.\n"
            "• Пиши звичайним чистим текстом БЕЗ Markdown-форматування (без **, *, #, ##, ###, `, ```)."
        )

        parts = [f"Період аналізу: останні {hours_label} ({total_items_desc})."]
        if hourly_digests:
            parts.append("=== ГОТОВІ ПОГОДИННІ ДАЙДЖЕСТИ ===\n" + "\n\n".join(hourly_digests))
        if recent_messages_text:
            parts.append("=== СВІЖІ ПОВІДОМЛЕННЯ (ЩЕ БЕЗ ДАЙДЖЕСТУ) ===\n" + recent_messages_text)

        prompt = "\n\n".join(parts)
        model_chain = self._build_model_chain(settings.gemini_summary_model, SUMMARY_FALLBACK_MODELS)

        try:
            summary = await self._generate_with_fallback(
                model_chain=model_chain,
                contents=prompt,
                system_instruction=system_instruction,
                temperature=0.0,
                use_search=False,
                minimal_thinking=True,
            )
            return f"📋 Підсумок чату за останні {hours_label} ({total_items_desc}):\n\n{summary}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Error generating summary via Gemini API: %s", e)
            fallback_parts = []
            if hourly_digests:
                fallback_parts.append("\n\n".join(hourly_digests))
            if recent_messages_text:
                fallback_parts.append(recent_messages_text)
            fallback_body = "\n\n".join(fallback_parts)[:3500]
            return (
                f"⚠️ Не вдалося об'єднати звіт через ліміт API. "
                f"Збережені дані за останні {hours_label}:\n\n{fallback_body}"
            )

async def generate_verified_summary(
    self,
    bundle: SummaryContextBundle,
    chat_id: int | None = None,
    chat_username: str | None = None,
    show_citations: bool = True,
    header_note: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, ChatSummarySchema | None]:
    """
    Generates structured JSON summary from transcript, validates all message_ids and participants
    via verify_and_prune_summary, and renders final clean text.
    """
    if bundle.single_digest_fast_path and bundle.message_count == 0 and bundle.digest_count == 1:
        fast_text = bundle.single_digest_fast_path
        if header_note:
            fast_text = f"ℹ️ {header_note}\n\n{fast_text}"
        return fast_text, None

    model_chain = self._build_model_chain(settings.gemini_summary_model, SUMMARY_FALLBACK_MODELS)
    raw_json_text = await self._generate_with_fallback(
        model_chain=model_chain,
        contents=bundle.transcript_text,
        system_instruction=SUMMARY_JSON_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION,
        temperature=0.0,
        use_search=False,
        minimal_thinking=True,
        response_mime_type="application/json",
        response_schema=ChatSummarySchema,
        raw_output=True,
    )

    parsed = parse_summary_json(raw_json_text)
    if parsed is None:
        logger.warning("Model returned invalid JSON during summary, retrying without response_schema.")
        raw_json_retry = await self._generate_with_fallback(
            model_chain=model_chain,
            contents=(
                f"{bundle.transcript_text}\n\n"
                "Поверни ВИКЛЮЧНО валідний JSON об'єкт за схемою ChatSummarySchema без жодного тексту навколо."
            ),
            system_instruction=SUMMARY_JSON_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION,
            temperature=0.0,
            use_search=False,
            minimal_thinking=True,
            response_mime_type="application/json",
            response_schema=None,
            raw_output=True,
        )
        parsed = parse_summary_json(raw_json_retry)
        if parsed is None:
            raise ValueError("Failed to parse model JSON response for chat summary.")

    verified = verify_and_prune_summary(
        parsed,
        bundle.valid_msg_ids,
        bundle.valid_speakers,
    )

    if getattr(settings, "summary_enable_self_check", False) and (
        verified.topics or verified.decisions_and_outcomes
    ):
        verified = await self._run_self_check_pass(bundle, verified, model_chain)

    rendered = render_summary_text(
        verified,
        chat_id=chat_id,
        chat_username=chat_username,
        show_citations=show_citations,
        header_note=header_note,
    )
    return rendered, verified

async def process_hourly_digest_for_chat(chat_id: int) -> bool:
    """
    Generates hourly digests from accumulated unprocessed chat messages
    in chronological order (up to 3 batches of 200 messages per execution),
    keeping DB transactions closed during external LLM network calls.
    """
    any_processed = False

    for _ in range(MAX_DIGEST_BATCHES_PER_RUN):
        # Step 1: Open session briefly to read batch and orphan parent replies
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            stmt = (
                select(ChatLog, User)
                .outerjoin(User, ChatLog.user_id == User.user_id)
                .where(ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id, ChatLog.is_processed.is_(False))
                .order_by(ChatLog.timestamp.asc(), ChatLog.message_id.asc())
                .limit(DIGEST_BATCH_SIZE)
            )
            raw_rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
            if not raw_rows:
                break

            rows: list[tuple[ChatLog, User | None]] = [(r[0], r[1]) for r in raw_rows]
            logs_only = [log for log, _ in rows]
            orphan_parents = await hydrate_orphan_parents(session, chat_id, logs_only)
            bundle = format_messages_for_digest(rows, orphan_parents)
            batch_msg_ids = [log.message_id for log in logs_only]
            p_start = bundle.period_start
            p_end = bundle.period_end

        # Step 2: Execute LLM call outside DB session to avoid locking SQLite
        verified: ChatSummarySchema | None = None
        if len(rows) <= 3:
            digest_text = "\n".join(f"• {line}" for line in bundle.raw_fallback_lines)
        else:
            try:
                digest_text, verified = await gemini_service.generate_verified_summary(
                    bundle,
                    chat_id=chat_id,
                    show_citations=False,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(
                    "Failed to generate hourly digest for chat %s: %s",
                    chat_id,
                    e,
                )
                break

            if not digest_text:
                break

        # Step 3: Open new session, verify chat wasn't /cleared while LLM was running
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            existing_count = (
                await session.execute(
                    select(func.count(ChatLog.message_id)).where(
                        ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id,
                        ChatLog.message_id.in_(batch_msg_ids),
                    )
                )
            ).scalar_one() or 0

            if existing_count == 0:
                logger.info(
                    "Messages in chat %s were deleted (/clear) during digest generation - save aborted.",
                    chat_id,
                )
                break

            new_digest = ChatDigest(
                chat_id=chat_id,
                digest_text=digest_text,
                period_start=p_start,
                period_end=p_end,
                message_count=existing_count,
                structured_json=verified.model_dump_json() if verified else None,
                created_at=utc_now(),
            )
            session.add(new_digest)

            await session.execute(
                update(ChatLog)
                .where(ChatLog.chat_id == chat_id, ChatLog.message_id.in_(batch_msg_ids))
                .values(is_processed=True)
            )
            await session.commit()
            any_processed = True
            logger.info(
                "Generated hourly digest for chat %s (%d messages).",
                chat_id,
                existing_count,
            )

        if len(rows) < DIGEST_BATCH_SIZE:
            break

    return any_processed

async def run_hourly_digest_and_cleanup_job() -> None:
    """
    Background hourly task:
    1) Generates hourly digests from unprocessed messages for each chat in isolation.
    2) Prunes outdated messages, digests (older than RETENTION_DAYS), and orphaned User records.
    """
    try:
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            stmt = (
                select(ChatLog.chat_id)
                .where(ChatLog.is_processed.is_(False))
                .group_by(ChatLog.chat_id)
            )
            chat_ids = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()

        for cid in chat_ids:
            try:
                await process_hourly_digest_for_chat(cid)
            except Exception as chat_err:
                logger.exception(
                    "Failed to generate hourly digest for chat %s: %s",
                    cid,
                    chat_err,
                )

        # Cleanup outdated records (default older than 7 days) and orphaned users
        cutoff_retention = utc_now() - timedelta(days=settings.retention_days)
        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(delete(ChatLog).where(ChatLog.timestamp < cutoff_retention))
            await session.execute(delete(ChatDigest).where(ChatDigest.created_at < cutoff_retention))
            active_users_subq = (
                select(ChatLog.user_id)
                .where(ChatLog.user_id.is_not(None))
                .distinct()
            )
            await session.execute(delete(User).where(User.user_id.not_in(active_users_subq)))
            await session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("Error in background hourly digest/cleanup job: %s", e)

def strip_markdown(text: str) -> str:
    """Strips Markdown formatting characters from text for clean Telegram display."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = re.sub(r"```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\n?", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*#{1,6}\s+", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*\*\s+", "• ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?<!\w)__(?![a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*__(?!\w))(.+?)__(?!\w)", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?<!\*)\*(?!\s)(.+?)(?<!\s)\*(?!\*)", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?<!\w)_([^\s_][^_]*?)_(?!\w)", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*[-*_]{3,}\s*$", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()

async def log_bot_message(
    bot_message: Message,
    reply_to_message: Message | None = None,
    text_override: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """
    Saves bot's own response into ChatLog (with is_bot_message=True and sender_name='Bot')
    so subsequent user replies and /summary have full conversational context.
    """
    try:
        if bot_message is None or getattr(bot_message, "chat", None) is None:
            return

        content_text = (
            text_override
            or getattr(bot_message, "text", None)
            or getattr(bot_message, "caption", None)
            or ""
        ).strip()[:4000]
        if not content_text:
            return

        now_utc = utc_now()
        from_user = getattr(bot_message, "from_user", None)
        bot_user_id = from_user.id if from_user is not None else None
        bot_username = getattr(from_user, "username", None) if from_user is not None else None
        bot_full_name = (
            (getattr(from_user, "full_name", None) or "Бот")[:128]
            if from_user is not None
            else "Бот"
        )

        reply_msg_id, reply_user_id, reply_author, reply_snippet = _extract_reply_metadata(
            bot_message,
            explicit_reply=reply_to_message,
        )
        thread_id = getattr(bot_message, "message_thread_id", None) or (
            getattr(reply_to_message, "message_thread_id", None)
            if reply_to_message is not None
            else None
        )

        async with async_session_factory() as session:
            if bot_user_id is not None:
                user_stmt = sqlite_upsert(User).values(
                    user_id=bot_user_id,
                    username=bot_username,
                    full_name=bot_full_name,
                    updated_at=now_utc,
                ).on_conflict_do_update(
                    index_elements=[User.user_id],
                    set_={
                        "username": bot_username,
                        "full_name": bot_full_name,
                        "updated_at": now_utc,
                    },
                )
                await session.execute(user_stmt)

            log_stmt = sqlite_upsert(ChatLog).values(
                chat_id=bot_message.chat.id,
                message_id=bot_message.message_id,
                user_id=bot_user_id,
                text=content_text,
                timestamp=now_utc,
                is_processed=False,
                reply_to_message_id=reply_msg_id,
                reply_to_user_id=reply_user_id,
                reply_to_author=reply_author,
                reply_to_snippet=reply_snippet,
                quote_text=None,
                message_thread_id=thread_id,
                media_type=None,
                forward_origin=None,
                sender_name="Бот",
                is_bot_message=True,
                edited_at=None,
            ).on_conflict_do_update(
                index_elements=[ChatLog.chat_id, ChatLog.message_id],
                set_={
                    "text": content_text,
                    "reply_to_message_id": reply_msg_id,
                    "reply_to_user_id": reply_user_id,
                    "reply_to_author": reply_author,
                    "reply_to_snippet": reply_snippet,
                    "message_thread_id": thread_id,
                    "sender_name": "Бот",
                    "is_bot_message": True,
                },
            )
            await session.execute(log_stmt)
            await session.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(
            "Failed to save bot response to ChatLog (chat_id=%s): %s",
            getattr(getattr(bot_message, "chat", None), "id", None),
            e,
        )

def format_citation_badge(
    evidence_msg_ids: list[int],
    chat_id: int | None = None,
    chat_username: str | None = None,
    max_links: int = 2,
) -> str:
    """
    Constructs compact citation link badge for a report item (up to max_links citations).
    """
    if not evidence_msg_ids or max_links <= 0:
        return ""

    unique_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(evidence_msg_ids))[:max_links]
    links = [format_message_link(chat_id, mid, chat_username) for mid in unique_ids]
    if not links:
        return ""

        label = "джерело" if len(links) == 1 else "джерела"
        return f" ({label}: {', '.join(links)})"

    return f" [{', '.join(links)}]"

def format_message_link(
    chat_id: int | None,
    message_id: int,
    chat_username: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Constructs link to specific Telegram message:
    - public chat with username -> https://t.me/<username>/<message_id>
    - private supergroup (-100...) -> https://t.me/c/<internal_id>/<message_id>
    - group without username or private chat -> #<message_id>
    """
    if chat_username and chat_username.strip():
        clean_username = chat_username.strip().lstrip("@")
        if clean_username:
            return f"https://t.me/{clean_username}/{message_id}"

    if chat_id is not None:
        chat_id_str = str(chat_id)
        if chat_id_str.startswith("-100") and len(chat_id_str) > 4:
            return f"https://t.me/c/{chat_id_str[4:]}/{message_id}"

    return f"#{message_id}"

def parse_summary_json(raw_text: str) -> ChatSummarySchema | None:
    """
    Parses JSON response from LLM, stripping markdown code blocks,
    and validates schema with ChatSummarySchema.
    """
    if not raw_text or not raw_text.strip():
        return None

    cleaned = raw_text.strip()
    cleaned = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", cleaned)
    cleaned = cleaned.strip()

    candidates: list[str] = [cleaned]
    first_brace = cleaned.find("{")
    last_brace = cleaned.rfind("}")
    if first_brace != -1 and last_brace != -1 and last_brace > first_brace:
        extracted = cleaned[first_brace : last_brace + 1]
        if extracted != cleaned:
            candidates.append(extracted)

    for candidate in candidates:
        for attempt_str in (candidate, re.sub(r",\s*([}\]])", r"\1", candidate)):
            try:
                data = json.loads(attempt_str)
                if isinstance(data, dict):
                    return ChatSummarySchema.model_validate(data)
            except Exception:
                continue

    logger.warning("Failed to parse summary JSON from LLM response (length=%d).", len(raw_text))
    return None

def render_summary_text(
    verified: ChatSummarySchema,
    chat_id: int | None = None,
    chat_username: str | None = None,
    show_citations: bool = True,
    header_note: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Renders verified ChatSummarySchema into clean plain text without markdown syntax.
    """
    sections: list[str] = []

    if header_note and header_note.strip():
        sections.append(_clean_plain_text(header_note))

    if verified.is_low_signal and not verified.topics and not verified.decisions_and_outcomes:
        base_msg = (
            "За цей період у чаті не було змістовних обговорень або конкретних домовленостей "
            "(переважно короткі репліки чи загальне спілкування)."
        )
        if verified.low_signal_reason and verified.low_signal_reason.strip():
            reason_clean = _clean_plain_text(verified.low_signal_reason)
            if reason_clean.lower() not in base_msg.lower():
                base_msg = f"{base_msg}\nПримітка: {reason_clean}"
        sections.append(base_msg)
        return "\n\n".join(sections)

    if verified.topics:
        topic_lines = ["1. Головні теми обговорення:"]
        for topic in verified.topics:
            title_clean = _clean_plain_text(topic.title)
            summary_clean = _clean_plain_text(topic.summary)
            participants_clean = [_clean_plain_text(p) for p in topic.participants if _clean_plain_text(p)]
            participants_str = f" ({', '.join(participants_clean)})" if participants_clean else ""
            citation_badge = (
                format_citation_badge(topic.evidence_msg_ids, chat_id=chat_id, chat_username=chat_username)
                if show_citations
                else ""
            )
            topic_lines.append(f"- {title_clean}{participants_str}: {summary_clean}{citation_badge}")
        sections.append("\n".join(topic_lines))

    if verified.decisions_and_outcomes:
        status_map = {
            "confirmed": "[Підтверджено]",
            "proposed": "[Пропозиція]",
            "open_question": "[Відкрите питання]",
        }
        decision_lines = ["2. Висновки, рішення та відкриті питання:"]
        for decision in verified.decisions_and_outcomes:
            status_prefix = status_map.get(decision.status, "[Пропозиція]")
            text_clean = _clean_plain_text(decision.text)
            participants_clean = [_clean_plain_text(p) for p in decision.participants if _clean_plain_text(p)]
            participants_str = f" ({', '.join(participants_clean)})" if participants_clean else ""
            citation_badge = (
                format_citation_badge(decision.evidence_msg_ids, chat_id=chat_id, chat_username=chat_username)
                if show_citations
                else ""
            )
            decision_lines.append(f"- {status_prefix} {text_clean}{participants_str}{citation_badge}")
        sections.append("\n".join(decision_lines))

    if verified.unverified_or_unclear_context:
        unclear_items = [_clean_plain_text(item) for item in verified.unverified_or_unclear_context if _clean_plain_text(item)]
        if unclear_items:
            unclear_lines = ["Неоднозначний контекст:"]
            for item in unclear_items:
                unclear_lines.append(f"- {item}")
            sections.append("\n".join(unclear_lines))

    return "\n\n".join(sections).strip()

def verify_and_prune_summary(
    parsed: ChatSummarySchema,
    valid_msg_ids: set[int],
    valid_speakers: set[str] | None = None,
) -> ChatSummarySchema:
    """
    Verifies generated summary against ground-truth message_ids and speaker names in window.
    Removes fabricated message_ids, drops items without valid evidence_msg_ids,
    and filters out hallucinated participants.
    """
    enforce_msg_ids = bool(valid_msg_ids)
    enforce_speakers = bool(valid_speakers)

    verified_topics: list[TopicItem] = []
    for topic in parsed.topics:
        if enforce_msg_ids:
            kept_ids: list[int] = []
            for mid in topic.evidence_msg_ids:
                if mid in valid_msg_ids and mid not in kept_ids:
                    kept_ids.append(mid)
            if not kept_ids:
                logger.debug("Pruned topic without valid message_ids: %s", topic.title)
                continue
        else:
            kept_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(topic.evidence_msg_ids))

        if enforce_speakers and valid_speakers:
            kept_participants = [
                p for p in topic.participants if _speaker_matches(p, valid_speakers)
            ]
        else:
            kept_participants = list(topic.participants)

        verified_topics.append(
            TopicItem(
                title=topic.title,
                summary=topic.summary,
                participants=kept_participants,
                evidence_msg_ids=kept_ids,
                thread_id=topic.thread_id,
            )
        )

    verified_decisions: list[DecisionItem] = []
    for decision in parsed.decisions_and_outcomes:
        if enforce_msg_ids:
            kept_ids = []
            for mid in decision.evidence_msg_ids:
                if mid in valid_msg_ids and mid not in kept_ids:
                    kept_ids.append(mid)
            if not kept_ids:
                logger.debug("Pruned decision/outcome without valid message_ids: %s", decision.text)
                continue
        else:
            kept_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(decision.evidence_msg_ids))

        if enforce_speakers and valid_speakers:
            kept_participants = [
                p for p in decision.participants if _speaker_matches(p, valid_speakers)
            ]
        else:
            kept_participants = list(decision.participants)

        verified_decisions.append(
            DecisionItem(
                text=decision.text,
                status=decision.status,
                participants=kept_participants,
                evidence_msg_ids=kept_ids,
            )
        )

    is_low_signal = parsed.is_low_signal
    low_signal_reason = parsed.low_signal_reason

    if not verified_topics and not verified_decisions:
        is_low_signal = True
        if not low_signal_reason:
            low_signal_reason = (
                "Не знайдено підтверджених змістовних тем або домовленостей у межах наявних повідомлень."
            )

    return ChatSummarySchema(
        is_low_signal=is_low_signal,
        low_signal_reason=low_signal_reason,
        topics=verified_topics,
        decisions_and_outcomes=verified_decisions,
        unverified_or_unclear_context=list(parsed.unverified_or_unclear_context),
    )
